title: OneCoin Ruja YLE1
description: OneCoin founder Dr. Ruja Ignatova interview in YLE1 Finland. Published by OneCoin Team Estonia. Onecoin.

asr.full_text: Nelore Nelore Nelore Since recent years hundreds of virtual currencies have been born. Known to be Bitcoin. One of the newest virtual currencies, OneCoin, is haunting normal people but it's value will not rise anyway. The virtual currency Bitcoin has gotten a certain number of new competitors, OneCoin started a new virtual currency in January at the age of three, it will take its first talk on virtual assets. The world of one coin started in January. Onecoin is now being the main topic for discussion. Onecoin's founder and owner, the Bulgarian Ruzsaintova, went to market its own currency in Helsinki. I have not seen cryptocurrency being marketed properly by business people. In the case of OneCoin itself, digital money is an early second-hand adventure. An investment in investment in one coin is expected to generate up to 1,000 euros. People should know what they do and how they use it. Instead of just buying something they will never make it work." This concerns the online market, where an inexperienced one has to hire new virtual currency. OneCoin's founder himself is abusing the product. Valtteri Maranen, OneCoin founder:"Whatever people do not understand, they tend to criticise." There's also competition outside, of course. I cannot guarantee, but I'm extremely optimistic. According to the company, OneCoin has over 70 000 members and 2 500 are Finns.

The narration says OneCoin's value will not rise and includes concerns about the product, while the founder's optimism and company membership claims are presented as interview/report material. The sampled ending shows OneCoin promotional branding and contact details, but does not establish a concrete request for viewers to send money or data.
